opex.note: Losses on merchant loans and cash advances, and transaction losses. Up 47% YoY as more sales flowed through Shopify Payments.

follow100Note: Merchant solutions brings in $73.73 of every $100 — mostly a cut of merchants' sales — but direct costs eat $50.47 of every $100 overall. A $1,021M paper loss on equity investments cost $40.25 of every $100, which is why the quarter ended with a net loss of $28.90 per $100 despite an $8.60 operating profit. Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.
footerNote: The earnings release prints a condensed statement (operating income $203M, net other expense including taxes of $885M, net loss $682M); the split of that $885M into other income, the equity-method loss and the tax benefit comes from the detailed statement in Shopify's Form 10-Q filed the same day, as the release itself directs.
oneTimers: A $908M after-tax paper loss from equity investments: a $1,021M net loss on equity and other investments — a $930M unrealized loss on stakes in public companies as share prices fell, plus an $86M unrealized loss on an investment option — plus a $23M loss on its equity-method investment (Flexport). Shopify says net income excluding the impact of equity investments was $226M (non-GAAP), versus a $682M GAAP net loss.
otherDetail: Other income of -$950M in total: a $1,021M paper loss on equity and other investments — mostly a $930M unrealized loss on stakes in public companies as share prices fell, plus an $86M unrealized loss on an investment option — partly offset by $65M of interest income and a $6M foreign-exchange gain. The $23M equity-method loss is the separate equityM line; the rest nets to otherIncomeM of -$950M.
pngFooterNote: Paper losses on equity stakes turned profit into a net loss.

segments.name: Subscription solutions
segments.note: The monthly plans merchants pay to run their stores on Shopify. Up 21% YoY; monthly recurring revenue reached $182M.

segments.name: Merchant solutions
segments.note: Mostly payment processing (Shopify Payments) — a cut of the sales flowing through merchants' stores — plus shipping and other merchant services. Up 29% YoY and 74% of all revenue.

sources.label: Form 10-Q — detailed statements of operations (SEC EDGAR)

takeaways.text: Revenue rose 27% to $2.36B as GMV grew 23% to $74.8B — the eighth straight quarter of pro forma revenue growth of 25% or more. Merchant solutions led, up 29% to $1.74B, while subscription revenue grew 21% to $620M and monthly recurring revenue reached $182M.
takeaways.title: Growth stayed strong

takeaways.text: Operating income rose 136% to $203M from $86M a year ago, as gross profit grew 22% to $1.17B while operating expenses rose only 11%. Free cash flow was $363M — 15% of revenue, the seventh straight quarter of double-digit free cash flow margins.
takeaways.title: Operating profit more than doubled

takeaways.text: Net loss was $682M, but $908M of it (after tax) was a paper loss on equity investments — a $930M unrealized loss on public-company stakes as share prices fell, plus an $86M unrealized loss on an investment option. Excluding equity investments, net income was $226M, up from $144M a year ago.
takeaways.title: Paper losses flipped the bottom line

verdict: Shopify grew revenue 27% to $2.4B and more than doubled operating income to $203M, but a $1,021M paper loss on equity investments swung the bottom line to a $682M net loss — excluding those investments, net income was $226M.
